name: @codemirror/view
localChanges: Package names, imports and build/test configuration use QuireKit workspace identities.
src/docview.ts: measure sibling gaps, assign trailing wrapper padding to its last block, and avoid accumulating skipped viewports' spacing.
src/docview.ts: lock content height before tile construction and component retirement so transient DOM shrinkage cannot clamp the outer scroll position.
src/buildtile.ts and src/docview.ts: retire previous parent links when DOM is reused; undo full reuse for merged input tiles.
src/buildtile.ts and src/tile.ts: keep virtual viewport gaps outside content wrappers and apply vertical wrapper edges only at real source boundaries, including reused fragments.
src/viewstate.ts: initialize a refreshed height map once before merging measurements from all mounted viewports.
src/viewstate.ts: keep an already mounted explicit scroll target stable before navigation, then recrop using the destination viewport after the scroll is consumed.
src/editorview.ts: give one explicit target scroll a separate bounded measurement phase after mounting the distant target.
src/editorview.ts, src/extension.ts and src/docview.ts: retain measured source anchors for outer scroll snapshots without synchronous geometry reads during capture.
src/dom.ts: resolve physical scroll owners by axis from both overflow dimensions and computed CSS, ignoring visible or clipped decoration overflow while retaining programmatic hidden scrolling.

src/cursor.ts, src/input.ts and src/domchange.ts: require mounted keyboard and pointer endpoints to own a positive-height line, excluding phantom font rectangles on collapsed rows and preserving corrected undirectional atomic ranges.
src/input.ts: end a composition whose compositionend the browser never sent when a new composition, a non-composing key or a pointer press with no composed DOM arrives.

src/buildtile.ts: keep DOM beside a composition in place: skip the empty tail after it so a widget starting at its end is preserved, walk zero-length tiles at an inserted composition, and reuse the widget buffer walked last.
